name: pandaDoc
author: ninja
description: This Node.js backend application is designed to facilitate real-time communication and peer connections using Socket.IO, enabling seamless chat functionality. It supports file handling, allowing users to upload and share files within the chat environment. Additionally, the backend includes a REST API that checks and manages user online status, ensuring that users can see who is currently active in the chat. The application is built with Express, providing a robust framework for handling HTTP requests and responses, making it efficient and scalable for real-time interactions.
